items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Fliver Ford played banjo and I played piano. And that was the band.

ctx.x: Well I'm getting confused on who played what instrument. Is it J.B.
Landry? J.B. Landry played alto sax. Tony Fougerat played trumpet. Mutt Powers played drums. Fliver Ford played banjo and I played piano. And that was the band.
Oh, they're on that phonograph? Uh huh.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: That's the unit that left the Sanger Theater with my wife in it and the unit that I played for. You remember the boys from Baton Rouge that I told you? Fliver Ford. Mm-hmm. Tony Fougerat. Me and Mutt Powers. Mutt's dead. Tony's dead. Fliver's dead. And J.B. I don't know if he's still alive.
